tools.name: sharepoint_search_sop_library
tools.description: Run a semantic/vector search against the SharePoint SOP Library, restricted to the current approved version, filtered by EquipmentType and optionally EquipmentModel, returning the matching document section (not the whole document).

tools.name: sharepoint_search_rca_archive
tools.description: Run a semantic/vector search against the SharePoint RCA (root cause analysis) archive for prior incidents matching an equipment type/model and symptom pattern, returning IncidentID, Equipment, RootCause, Date, and excerpt.

tools.name: sharepoint_search_oem_manuals
tools.description: Run a semantic/vector search against the SharePoint OEM manuals library for manufacturer failure-mode and troubleshooting documentation matching an equipment model.

tools.name: sharepoint_upload_ai_generated_report
tools.description: Upload a finalized AI-generated diagnostic/RCA report file into the 'AI-Generated' subfolder of the RCA archive, tagged with the AI-Generated metadata column. This is a write action: the report is staged in the AI-Generated subfolder only and requires a human review step before it may be promoted into the approved SOP/RCA library.

target_path.description: Destination path within the AI-Generated subfolder.
